headlines.title: Kentucky governor tells Mitch McConnell: Prove you can serve or ‘resign’
headlines.description: Gov. Andy Beshear issued his ultimatum in letters to McConnell and Senate Majority Leader John Thune, warning that he may begin the process of replacing him.

headlines.title: How Ken Martin is holding on as DNC chair — for now: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into Ken Martin’s woes at the Democratic National Committee.

headlines.title: Trump delivers emotional tribute at funeral for Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: President Trump delivered an emotional eulogy at the funeral for Senator Lindsey Graham. The leaders of Ukraine and Israel, who Graham strongly supported, were also in attendance. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Olympic canoeist's lawyers accuse DOJ of misleading grand jury in Reflecting Pool case
headlines.description: A key grand jury witness in a case against a former Olympic canoeist, who is accused of tampering with the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, testified that the area was already damaged and would have required repairs regardless, lawyers said in a court filing. David “Davey” Hearn pleaded not guilty after being accused of damaging the liner of the Reflecting Pool. NBC News' Ryan Reilly explains.

headlines.title: ‘I’m tired’: Lindsey Graham in never-before-seen video as he tried to secure deal to end Ukraine war
headlines.description: Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker sits down with documentary filmmaker Alex Holder who spent more four years following Senator Graham right until his death. Holder shares never-before-seen footage of Senator Graham raising concerns about “war fatigue” in Ukraine and a conversation between Lindsey and his sister Darline Graham about his entry into politics.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump hasn’t asked the Supreme Court to rehear birthright citizenship case despite his vow
headlines.description: The White House‘s deadline to ask the Supreme Court to reconsider the ruling that struck down Trump’s effort to limit birthright citizenship was Monday night.

headlines.title: Washington says goodbye to Sen. Lindsey Graham, a ‘true American original’
headlines.description: A special ceremony at the Capitol and a funeral service at the National Cathedral were held Tuesday. A second service is planned for Wednesday in Graham’s native South Carolina.

headlines.title: Netanyahu joins Trump for high-stakes meeting at the White House
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with President Donald Trump and attended Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: Witness in Reflecting Pool case conceded damage before canoeist touched water

headlines.title: Can Susan Collins defy political gravity again? From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump, Congress and world leaders to honor the late Sen. Lindsey Graham in Washington
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will be in attendance Tuesday. A funeral service in South Carolina will follow Wednesday.
